submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.086% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. Systematic simulations across the allowed thickness range (2-10mm) for all three candidate materials show that F2 at 4mm outperforms F3 at its optimum (3.749% at 5mm) and F1 at its optimum (5.144% at 4mm). All three candidate materials are listed in the project specifications and remain viable options with no documented activation or maintenance concerns, indicating pre-screening for hands-on maintenance compatibility. The choice of F2 at 4mm meets all constraints while delivering superior performance for the primary goal of achieving the best possible energy resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 4mm achieves 3.086% resolution, better than F3 (3.749% at 5mm optimum) and F1 (5.144% at 4mm optimum)
